about: Knock Off takes the item off, and the Pokemon can then take another (Pokemon Central, Privazione: from the fifth generation). In the Violet Gym, Falkner's Hoothoot is made to know Knock Off alone and to hold a Silk Scarf, the player's Snorlax to hold Leftovers and know Thief (set:, teach:). Hoothoot, the faster, knocks off the Leftovers; the Snorlax's Thief then takes the Silk Scarf in the same turn. Retail's mark, kept until this change, refused the Thief of a Pokemon whose own item was knocked off.

lines: The opposing Hoothoot used Knock Off!
